# LicenseTier

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The BonniePDF licence tiers.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Evaluation`: Internal evaluation, development, testing, security review, proof of concept, and non-production staging. Not time-limited, and fully functional — but not permitted for production use. Declaring it produces a one-time warning. Learn more
- `Community`: Free under the BonniePDF Community License: qualifying personal, charity, education, research and open-source use, and commercial production use while the benefiting organisation's annual gross revenue is below US $1,000,000 (aggregated with its affiliates). Learn more
- `Professional`: Paid: one named legal entity, unlimited developers. Learn more
- `Enterprise`: Paid: a named legal entity and the affiliates covered by its Order. Learn more
